title: Photo Mask Technician
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Responsibilities:

  • Inspect and judge reticles following standard operating procedures (SOP) or training knowledge, while leveraging AI-enabled tools to enhance inspection accuracy and decision consistency.
  • Operate in the Fab and Photo area, maintaining strict adherence to safety and quality standards, and utilizing AI insights or digital systems to support real-time monitoring and issue identification.
  • Successfully implement day and night shift rotations to support continuous production, using AI-assisted tools to optimize shift handover, summarize key issues, and track production status
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to determine and resolve issues, applying AI as a thinking partner for troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and solution recommendations.
  • Actively utilize AI tools (e.g., Copilot, GenieLLM) to generate summaries, draft communications, and organize work, improving efficiency and reducing manual workload.
  • Proactively acquire and apply relevant knowledge, including AI capabilities, to continuously improve performance and support digital and AI transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure responsible and secure use of AI tools by following company data protection, governance, and ethical guidelines.

 

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, with openness to integrating AI tools into daily workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality results, supported by AI-assisted analysis and insights.
  • Willingness to adapt to day and night shift rotations while leveraging digital/AI tools to maintain consistency and productivity.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply AI tools for data analysis, troubleshooting, and decision support.
  • Basic understanding of AI tools (e.g., Copilot, data analysis tools) or willingness to learn and apply them in daily work.
  • Ability to strictly follow SOPs and training while ensuring compliance with AI governance and data security requirements.

 

Education and Experience:

  • Requires an associate degree or equivalent experience; technical or vocational training is a plus.
  • Previous experience in manufacturing, preferably semiconductor industry.
  • Demonstrated capability to quickly learn new technologies, including AI-enabled tools and digital systems.
  • Experience using digital tools, automation systems, or data-driven platforms is a plus.
  • Cleanroom experience is desirable but not mandatory.

Working Hours & Salary:

  • Working hours follow a 12-hour rotating shift schedule based on a 4-3 / 3-4 pattern, with day and night shifts rotating every 3 to 4 months.

  • Salary start from NTD37,500

 

Support Micron’s AI transformation by adopting AI-enabled workflows, improving productivity, and contributing ideas to enhance operations through automation, data insights, and continuous improvement initiatives.

About Micron Technology, Inc.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.
